rationale: The replication demonstrates stability of a seeded hexagonal skyrmion lattice with integer topological charge (|Q|≈1 per core) and its field-driven collapse to a single-domain FE state, matching the paper's qualitative headline. However, the spontaneous field-INDUCED emergence of SkX from a labyrinth phase—the paper's central mechanism—was not reproduced; skyrmions were planted rather than nucleated. The T-E phase diagram, low-field L/S phases, quantitative MV/cm thresholds, and Kittel scaling were not tested. Reduced 2D model with arbitrary units limits quantitative comparison.
